newsitem.title: FINLAND: FEC SAYS AIMS FOR SHAPE OF LISTED COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: FEC SAYS AIMS FOR SHAPE OF LISTED COMPANY.

text.p: Finnish state-owned financing company Finnish Export Credit (FEC) said on Tuesday its target was to seek reaching the performance of a listed company.

"A good guiding principle of operations is to qualify for a listing ... This requires among others, that return on equity is competitive and solidity is high," FEC said in a statement, but did not say whether it planned to seek a listing.

FEC earlier released its 1996 report, which showed return on equity down at 5.7 percent from 8.0 percent in 1995. Its capital adequacy fell to 32.9 percent from 40.5 percent. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
